keyword: was there a rocket launch today
claims: SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 rocket carrying 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 7:49 p.m. PT (SLC-4E).
SpaceX's Falcon 9 launch followed a previous delay due to upper-level winds.
A Northrop Grumman Minotaur IV rocket is scheduled for a DoD mission on Tuesday, April 7, 2026, from Vandenberg Space Force Base.
